supporting_observations.claim: At 13:48:08 UTC, a Windows event on WS-KNGUYEN-01 records SYSTEM using PowerShell with explicit credentials targeting svc-routes on FILE-COP-01.
The event records an explicit-credential attempt, but does not establish whether authentication succeeded or failed.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec logs were not collected from DC-COP-01 or FILE-COP-01 between 13:30 and 14:15 UTC on 2026-09-15, overlapping the alert period.
Sysmon logs were not collected from DC-COP-01 or FILE-COP-01 during that same interval.
The available event is a single explicit-credential event; it does not show the repeated failed domain logons described by the alert.
claims_not_established: Whether svc-routes authentication attempts actually failed, succeeded, or repeated during the alert period.
Whether the PowerShell activity was an authorized part of the scheduled svc-routes password rotation and job update.
What command or script PowerShell executed, who initiated it, or what process launched it.
Whether the svc-routes credential was exposed or misused.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain domain-controller and FILE-COP-01 authentication logs for 13:20–14:20 UTC, including failure and success events for svc-routes.
Collect process creation, PowerShell, and logon context from WS-KNGUYEN-01 around 13:48 UTC, including command line, parent process, and initiating user.
Verify the password-rotation completion and RouteSync update records, and compare their timing and operator with the observed event.
